comments.author: Andrea
comments.text:
Hello Simon, thank you a lot for your site. I loved it. I am from Chile (South America).

Today I took the speaking section, I'd like to share my questions:

-First part: about to ride a bicycle: whether in my country people ride or not, why people like it, if in the future will increse de number of people riding, if I used to ride when I was a girl.

-If I sang in the primary school, if I think the lyrics are important.

-Cue card: about a famous person and why she/he is famous in my country

-Part 3: if it is necessary to have some talent to be a famous person today, why do famous people like being famous, what happend with the family of someone famous, why do people enjoy watching reality shows, If I'd like to be a famous person.
